Office wifi changes on November 10

On November 10, the guest wifi network changes its name from Visitor to Harbor-Guest. The password rotates monthly and appears on the screen at reception.

Staff laptops should use the Harbor-Staff network, which authenticates with your badge certificate; no password is needed. If your laptop does not join automatically, open the Company Portal app and run the network profile check.

Contact the help desk through Slack at #it-help if you have trouble.
